citations.claim: cart position exceeds track limit at first violating step
cart approaching track end one step before violation
cart already near track end five steps before violation with positive velocity

explanation: Controller with gains adapted to plant fails to brake cart drift: starting at x=0.5 v=0.5 with light cart (0.5kg) and heavy/long pole, controller force stays ~0.5N (far below 40N limit) while cart velocity ~1.3-1.37 m/s carries it off track at step 95. Pole stays upright (theta~0.067), so balancing is prioritized over cart centering / track constraint.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart drifts steadily rightward toward and past the track end from step 92 to step 95 while the pole stays nearly upright. By step 95 the cart is at the far right edge off the track, with the pole still balanced and no visible correction.
